fusions.name: Rising Palisade
fusions.desc: Raises a row of upright gusts 5 tiles long for 5 seconds. It deals 11 damage to each enemy that crosses it and knocks it back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Dropped Shutter
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Drops a column of air on the first enemy in its path that deals 20 damage and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Becalmed
fusions.desc: After a 1-second cast, stills the air and holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Pacing the Bars
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. When it reaches 6, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
